Never write that path directly. lib.web.handlers auto-loads it. Never edit solve.py's dispatch or lib/web/handlers/__init__.py (two web chains may run at once). Key on a concept clue KEY -- never on proof-N or a target slot: Mastery puts today's class on ANY of its 3 targets. (The answer-first worker usually promotes it before CORRECT; a codify worker hardens it after.)
